overview.about: The KPMG Women's PGA Championship is one of the five majors in women's golf, run jointly by the PGA of America and the LPGA. Played on strong championship courses, it carries one of the biggest purses in the women's game and a place among the sport's most coveted titles.
overview.nextEvent: The next KPMG Women's PGA Championship is played at a championship venue, this edition at Congressional Country Club near Washington, D.C. As a major it gathers the world's leading women professionals for a top prize.
